notes: The mappings cite the pinned HLAfederation MOM definitions in the IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM under the federation MOM requirements. Installed-package results are bounded provider evidence and do not establish provider-independent conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard HLAfederation MOM object class is published with one RTI-registered instance per federation execution, and the RTI supplies attribute values through the ordinary instance-attribute update mechanism when requested. The scenario discovers the standard HLAfederation instance and obtains its requested static identity values through the public request/reflection path.

HLAfederationName is a required static HLAunicodeString attribute with HLAreliable transportation and receive order. Its value is the name of the federation execution to which the joined federate belongs; the scenario verifies the reflected value equals the federation name it created.

HLARTIversion is a required static HLAunicodeString attribute with HLAreliable transportation and receive order and represents the RTI software version. The scenario checks that its requested value is supplied and non-empty while deliberately imposing no provider-specific version syntax or value.

HLAMIMdesignator is a required static HLAunicodeString attribute with HLAreliable transportation and receive order. When the RTI supplies the standard MIM, its value is HLAstandardMIM; the scenario requests and decodes the value and checks this prescribed designator.

HLAtimeImplementationName is a required static HLAunicodeString attribute with HLAreliable transportation and receive order. Its value is the time-implementation name supplied at federation creation; the scenario verifies the reflected value equals the adapter-supplied creation argument.
